title: 第一卷 第17章 本夫人助你突破第一卷 第6章 淬体成功踏入武者行列
slug: 逆主马奴我以阴阳证大道
lines: 王龙笑着躬身。
“多谢大小姐宽宏大量。”
秦明岚哼了一声，转过身，背对着他。
低头看着手中的树枝，看着树枝尖端那一缕尚未散尽的灵气，嘴角不自觉地翘了起来。
自己的剑修梦，如此触手可及。
“老东西。”
秦明岚声音轻飘飘的。
“明天……还教吗？”
王龙看着她的背影，连忙恭敬地表态。
“大小姐想学，老奴自然会全力教授。”
秦明岚很满意这个回答，但想着刚才王龙对自己动手动脚，语气有些不自然。
“那……明日本小姐来找你，老东西，你可要好好教！”
她说着转过身，对着王龙握了握拳头，威胁的模样着实可爱。
“若是教的不满意，本小姐可不会放过你！”
说完，也不等王龙回应，抬脚就往外走。
步伐很快，像是在逃跑。
走到院门口时，她忽然停下脚步，侧过头，露出半张红透的脸。
“今天的事……不许告诉我嫂子！”
“老奴明白。”
王龙开心极了，他还怕秦明岚告诉洛寒衣呢。
没想到这小丫头居然会主动隐瞒，正合他意。
秦明岚咬了咬嘴唇，又看了王龙一眼，这才转身离开。
王龙站在院子里，看着空荡荡的院门，低头看了看自己的手。
掌心还残留着她腰间的温度和触感。
这小丫头，比想象中好骗。
“小丫头片子。”
王龙喃喃自语，浑浊的老眼里闪过一丝精光。
“早晚让你心甘情愿的服侍老夫！”
夜幕降临，侯府笼罩在一片沉沉的夜色中。
王龙盘坐在新院子的床榻上，闭目调息。
白日里教秦明岚剑诀，消耗不小，但收获更大。
那丫头天资卓绝，一点就通，短短半个时辰就领悟到了剑气。
这份悟性，确实配得上ss级的资质评价。
王龙睁开眼，浑浊的老眼中闪过一丝精光。
子时将至。
该去洛寒衣那里了。
想着今晚可以跟洛寒衣继续双修，王龙十分亢奋，感觉全身有用不完的劲。
他站起身，活动了一下筋骨，推门而出。
夜风裹着雪沫子打在脸上，凉丝丝的，却浇不灭心头那团火。
洛寒衣的院子离得不远，穿过两道月洞门就到了。
院中的红烛依旧亮着，橘黄色的光芒透过窗棂，在雪地上投下一片温暖的光晕。
content_en:
Wang Lung smiled and bowed.
"Thank you for your generosity, Miss."
Qin Minglan snorted and turned around, facing away from him.
He looked down at the branch in his hand, looking at the wisp of spiritual energy at the tip of the branch that had not yet dissipated, and the corners of his mouth curled up unconsciously.
My dream of sword cultivation is so within reach.
"Old thing."
Qin Minglan's voice was light and airy.
"Will you teach again tomorrow?"
Wang Long looked at her back and quickly expressed his stance respectfully.
"If the eldest lady wants to learn, the old slave will naturally teach her with all her strength."
Qin Minglan was very satisfied with this answer, but thinking about what Wang Long had done to her just now, her tone was a little unnatural.
"Then... Miss Japan will come to you tomorrow, old man, you have to teach me well!"
As she spoke, she turned around and shook her fist at Wang Lung. Her threatening look was really cute.
"If you are not satisfied with the teaching, I will not let you go!"
After saying that, without waiting for Wang Long to respond, he raised his feet and walked out.
The pace is fast, as if running away.
When she reached the entrance of the courtyard, she suddenly stopped and turned her head, revealing half of her red face.
"What happened today...don't tell my sister-in-law!"
"Old slave understands."
Wang Long was very happy, but he was afraid that Qin Minglan would tell Luo Hanyi.
He didn't expect that this little girl would take the initiative to conceal it, which was exactly what he wanted.
Qin Minglan bit her lip, glanced at Wang Long again, and then turned and left.
Wang Long stood in the courtyard, looked at the empty courtyard door, and looked down at his hands.
The warmth and touch of her waist still remained in his palm.
This little girl is easier to deceive than expected.
"Little girl movie."
Wang Long murmured to himself, a glimmer of light flashing in his cloudy old eyes.
"I will let you serve me willingly sooner or later!"
As night fell, the Hou Mansion was shrouded in darkness.
Wang Long sat cross-legged on the bed in the new courtyard, closing his eyes and regulating his breath.
Teaching Qin Minglan sword techniques during the day consumes a lot of money, but the rewards are even greater.
That girl was extremely talented and knew everything about it, and she realized the sword energy in just half an hour.
This understanding is indeed worthy of the SS-level qualification evaluation.
Wang Long opened his eyes, and a glimmer of light flashed in his cloudy old eyes.
The hour is approaching.
It's time to go to Luo Hanyi's place.
Thinking that he and Luo Hanyi could continue their double cultivation tonight, Wang Long was very excited and felt that his whole body had endless energy.
He stood up, stretched his muscles, and pushed out the door.
The night wind was covered with snow foam and hit my face, which was slightly cool, but it couldn't extinguish the fire in my heart.
Luo Hanyi's yard is not far away, just pass through two moon cave doors.
The red candle in the courtyard was still on, and the orange light filtered through the window lattice, casting a warm halo on the snow.
